snp1.8:0.2: This sutta is identical with Khp 9.
snp1.8:7.4: The mother-and-child image is sometimes misread as saying one should protect all beings the way a mother protects her only child. Actually the comparison is between the child and one's own cultivation of goodwill: one should guard one's goodwill toward all beings the way a mother guards her only child. See MN 21.
snp1.8:9.3: This line should be read together with the Buddha's own definition of mindfulness as the ability to keep something in mind. See SN 48:10.
